metaData.originalTitle: Announcing Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare
metaData.title: Announcing Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Cloudflare and Anthropic have launched an integration that allows Claude Managed Agents to run code execution, secure connections, and custom tool calls on Cloudflare's infrastructure, decoupling the agent's brain from its hands.
metaData.summary: This article announces a new integration between Cloudflare and Anthropic, enabling developers to run Claude Managed Agents using Cloudflare's infrastructure for code execution, security, and observability. The integration decouples the agent's reasoning loop (run on Anthropic) from its execution environment (run on Cloudflare), providing enhanced security through customizable proxies, sandbox control with detailed metrics and SSH access, lightweight V8 isolate sandboxes for massive scale, and private service connectivity via Cloudflare Mesh and Workers VPC. It also includes built-in tools for browser control, email, and custom tool extensions, all deployable from a default template. The article highlights Cloudflare's broader agent ecosystem including Sandboxes, Agents SDK, Browser Run, and Dynamic Workers, positioning Cloudflare as a flexible, secure, and programmable platform for running agents at Internet scale.

mainPoints.point: The integration decouples the agent's reasoning loop from its execution environment.
mainPoints.explanation: Claude's core agent loop runs on Anthropic (the brain), while code execution, tool calls, and network access run on Cloudflare (the hands), giving developers more control over infrastructure.

mainPoints.point: Cloudflare provides lightweight V8 isolate sandboxes as a faster, cheaper alternative to microVMs.
mainPoints.explanation: For workloads that don't require full Linux environments, isolates boot in milliseconds and scale to tens of thousands of concurrent agents, minimizing infrastructure costs.

mainPoints.point: Security is enhanced through customizable outbound proxies and private network connectivity.
mainPoints.explanation: Agents can securely inject credentials, prevent data exfiltration, and connect to private services via Cloudflare Mesh or Workers VPC without exposing them to the public Internet.

mainPoints.point: The integration ships with built-in tools for browsers, email, and custom extensions.
mainPoints.explanation: Agents get immediate access to browser control, email inboxes, and a framework for adding custom tools using Cloudflare's developer platform services like R2 and Workers AI.

keyQuotes: Our goal is to make Cloudflare the simplest, most secure, and most programmable cloud for agents.

Anthropic describes this as 'decoupling the brain from the hands.' The core agent loop runs in Anthropic (the 'brain'), but the infrastructure for running and executing code (the 'hands') can be run anywhere, including Cloudflare.
If we're constantly running a full microVM per agent, we'll be unnecessarily burning a ton of resources and money to enable this scale.
You don't have to worry about infrastructure or scaling -- just write a few lines of code and hit deploy.

relatedArticles.title: Project Think: building the next generation of AI agents on Cloudflare
